name: Dragonling Teen
description: The Winterworks teen Dragonling: a lean, rideable young Ender Dragon in vanilla style: black scales, a long flat box snout with nostril bumps and teeth over a separate jaw, swept-back horn plates, flat 3 x 2 glowing violet eyes, light grey spines from crown to tail tip, big flat membrane wings on bony finger spars folded at rest, a long spined tail, a saddle the renderer can hide, and transparent armour shells that the armour textures paint. Minecraft pixel units, density 1: exports 1:1 to a vanilla entity model.
